meta.name: cli-e2e-testcase-writer
meta.description: Use when adding or updating Go CLI E2E coverage for one `tests/cli_e2e/{domain}` domain of the compiled `lark-cli`, especially when the work requires live `--help` or `schema` exploration, scenario-based `clie2e.RunCmd` workflows, and per-domain `coverage.md` maintenance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为Go CLI命令编写端到端测试用例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Go CLI项目中添加或维护端到端测试
copy.tagline_en: Write end-to-end test cases for Go CLI commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add or maintain end-to-end tests in a Go CLI project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为指定的 Go CLI 领域编写端到端测试用例，并生成覆盖率报告。它会先探索 CLI 命令，然后编写自包含的场景化测试，最后更新覆盖率文档。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 `lark-cli` 的某个领域（如 `tests/cli_e2e/{domain}`）添加或更新 Go CLI 端到端测试覆盖率时触发。

say.text: 为 task 领域编写端到端测试用例。
更新 project 领域的覆盖率文档。
say.note: Claude 会重新计算分母并更新命令表。

say.text: 为 user 领域添加一个工作流测试。
say.note: Claude 会创建测试文件并确保测试可运行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes end-to-end test cases for a specified Go CLI domain and generates a coverage report. It first explores the CLI commands, then writes self-contained scenario-based tests, and finally updates the coverage document.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add or update Go CLI E2E test coverage for a domain of `lark-cli`, such as `tests/cli_e2e/{domain}`.

say_en.text: Write end-to-end test cases for the task domain.
say_en.note: Claude will explore task commands, write tests, and update coverage report.

say_en.text: Update the coverage document for the project domain.
say_en.note: Claude will recompute denominator and update the command table.

say_en.text: Add a workflow test for the user domain.
say_en.note: Claude will create test files and ensure tests are runnable.
